description: Definite-integral (អាំងតេក្រាលកំណត់) drills: bracket-notation antiderivative evaluation [F(x)]_a^b, direct power-rule definite integrals, trig/exponential definite integrals, u-substitution definite integrals (power/log/trig forms), linear-argument and partial-fraction definite integrals, integration by parts, partial-fraction decomposition combined with a definite integral, and area-between-curve(s) problems (with accompanying sketch descriptions).

source.description: Cambodian BAC II grade-12 math exercise compendium (Start Up Community), Lesson 9: អាំងតេក្រាលកំណត់ (Definite Integrals) — exercises only, no worked solutions
source.extracted_by: manual OCR/transcription from scanned textbook (Claude Code), 2026-08-29

exercises.technique: Evaluate using the fundamental theorem bracket notation [f(x)]_a^b=f(b)-f(a), including linearity [n\cdot f(x)]_a^b=n[f(b)-f(a)]

exercises.prompt_latex: \int_0^1(e^x+x)dx;\ \int_0^{\ln2}(4-3e^x)dx;\ \int_{-1}^0\frac{3e^x-e}2dx;\ \int_0^{\pi/2}(2+3\sin x)dx;\ \int_{\pi/6}^{\pi/3}\left(\frac12-\frac23\sin x\right)dx;\ \int_{\pi/4}^\pi\left(8-\sqrt2\sin x+\frac{\cos x}{\sqrt2}\right)dx;\ \int_{\pi/3}^{\pi/2}(\sin x+2\cos x)dx;\ \int_{\pi/3}^{\pi/2}\left(2-\frac{3\cos x-2}2\right)dx;\ \int_0^{\pi/4}\frac{\sin^2x-\cos^2x}{\sin x+\cos x}dx;\ \int_{\pi/6}^{\pi/4}\frac{2\cos2x}{\cos x-\sin x}dx;\ \int_{\pi/4}^{\pi/3}(\tan^2x+1)dx;\ \int_{\pi/6}^{\pi/3}(2+\cot^2x)dx;\ \int_{-\pi/4}^{\pi/3}\frac{3\,dx}{\cos^2x};\ \int_{\pi/6}^{\pi/4}\frac{2-\sin^2x}{\sin^2x}dx;\ \int_{\pi/6}^{\pi/3}\frac{\cos^2x+3}{2\sin^2x}dx
exercises.technique: Combine antiderivative_exponential/antiderivative_trig/antiderivative_trig_sec with bounds, including sin^2-cos^2 simplification via sin x+cos x factoring

exercises.prompt_latex: \int_2^3 2(x-2)^3dx;\ \int_2^4(x-1)(x^2-2x+1)^2dx;\ \int_0^1 5x^2(2-x^3)^4dx;\ \int_0^{\ln2}e^x(e^x-1)^2dx;\ \int_0^{\ln3}(e^x-2)(e^x-2x+1)^3dx;\ \int_{\ln2}^{\ln3}\frac{4e^x}{(1-e^x)^3}dx;\ \int_1^e\frac2x\ln x\,dx;\ \int_e^{e^2}\frac{1+\ln x}xdx;\ \int_1^e\frac{3(\ln x)^2}{2x}dx;\ \int_{\pi/3}^{\pi/2}\sin x(1-\cos^2x)dx;\ \int_0^{\pi/6}\cos x\sin x\,dx;\ \int_{\pi/4}^{\pi}3\cos x\sin^5x\,dx
exercises.technique: u_substitution with bounds: u'u^n and u'/u forms, u=e^x, u=\ln x, u=\sin x, u=\cos x

exercises.prompt_latex: \int_2^3\frac2{x-1}dx;\ \int_0^1\frac4{2x+1}dx;\ \int_{\sqrt2}^2\frac x{x^2-1}dx;\ \int_2^3\frac{2x+1}{x^2+x-1}dx;\ \int_0^1\frac{dx}{(2x-1)^2};\ \int_0^3\frac3{\sqrt{x+1}}dx;\ \int_2^3\frac{6x}{\sqrt{x^2-1}}dx;\ \int_{-1}^0\frac{x-1}{(2x-x^2+1)^2}dx;\ \int_0^{\ln2}\frac{e^x}{e^x+1}dx;\ \int_{\ln2}^{\ln3}\frac{3e^x}{(2e^x-1)^2}dx;\ \int_0^{\ln2}\frac{2e^x-1}{\sqrt{4e^x-2x}}dx;\ \int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{2\cos x}{\sin x+1}dx;\ \int_{\pi/3}^{\pi/2}\frac{\sin x}{2\cos^2x}dx;\ \int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{\cos x}{(3-2\sin x)^2}dx;\ \int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{\cos x-\sin x}{\sqrt{\cos x+\sin x}}dx;\ \int_2^4\left(2-\frac1{2x-3}\right)dx;\ \int_{-2}^0\left(x-\frac2{(x-1)^2}\right)dx;\ \int_2^3\left(\frac2x-\frac1{x-1}+\frac3{(x-1)^2}\right)dx
exercises.technique: linear_argument_rule / partial-fraction-shaped rational integrands, combined with bounds
Mixed sum definite integrals combining exponential, trig linear-argument, and angle-shift identities

exercises.prompt_latex: \int_0^{\pi/4}\sin^2x\,dx;\ \int_{\pi/4}^\pi4\cos^2x\,dx;\ \int_{\pi/4}^{\pi/6}\tan x\,dx;\ \int_{\pi/6}^{\pi/3}\cot x\,dx;\ \int_{\pi/6}^{2\pi/3}\sin^3x\,dx;\ \int_{\pi/4}^\pi\cos^3x\,dx;\ \int_{-\pi/4}^{\pi/6}3\cot^3x\,dx;\ \int_{-\pi/4}^{\pi/3}2\tan^3x\,dx;\ \int_{\pi/4}^{\pi/2}3\sin x\sin2x\,dx;\ \int_{\pi/4}^{\pi/3}\sin^2x\cos^2x\,dx;\ \int_0^{\pi/3}\sin2x\sin3x\,dx;\ \int_{\pi/2}^\pi\cos6x\cos3x\,dx;\ \int_{-1}^1 xe^x\,dx;\ \int_0^{\ln2}(2x-1)e^{-x}dx;\ \int_0^{\pi/3}2x\cos x\,dx;\ \int_{\pi/6}^{\pi/3}(1-x)\sin x\,dx;\ \int_0^\pi x\sin2x\,dx;\ \int_0^{\pi/2}(2x+3)\cos(x-1)dx;\ \int_1^e\ln x\,dx;\ \int_e^{2e}2x\ln x\,dx
exercises.technique: Trig power-reduction (odd-power via Pythagorean identity, product-to-sum) and integration_by_parts with bounds

exercises.prompt_latex: \int_0^13\ln(x+1)dx;\ \int_{-1}^0x^2e^{-x}dx;\ \int_0^{\pi/4}x^2\cos x\,dx;\ \int_0^{\pi/2}x^2\sin2x\,dx;\ f(x)=\frac{2x-3}{x+1}:\ \text{find }a,b\text{ s.t. }f(x)=a+\frac b{x+1};\ \text{compute }I=\int_0^2f(x)dx;\ \text{find }a,b,c\text{ s.t. }\frac{3x^2+4x-1}{2-x}=ax+b+\frac c{2-x};\ \text{compute}\int_0^1\frac{3x^2+4x-1}{2-x}dx;\ f(x)=\frac{-x}{(x-2)^2}:\ \text{simplify }f(x)=\frac a{x-2}+\frac b{(x-2)^2};\ \text{compute }A=\int_{-1}^0f(x)dx;\ f(x)=\frac{x^2+6x+7}{(x+2)(x+3)}:\ \text{find }A,B,C\text{ s.t. }f(x)=A+\frac B{x+2}+\frac C{x+3};\ \text{compute}\int_0^1f(x)dx;\ g(x)=\frac{x^3}{x^2-2x+1}:\ \text{find }a,b,c,d\text{ s.t. }g(x)=ax+b+\frac c{x-1}+\frac d{(x-1)^2};\ \text{find }f(x)=\int g(x)dx\text{ with }f(2)=5;\ \text{compute }I=\int_2^3g(x)dx
exercises.technique: By-parts definite integrals, plus partial-fraction decomposition (find unknown coefficients) followed by a definite integral

exercises.prompt_latex: f(x)=\frac{x^3+13x+4}{(x+2)(x-1)^2}=\frac m{x+2}+\frac n{x-1}+\frac p{(x-1)^2},\ x\ne\{-2,1\}:\ \text{find }m,n,p;\ \text{find }F(x)=\int f(x)dx\text{ with }F(2)=4\ln2;\ \text{compute }J=\int_2^3f(x)dx
exercises.technique: Partial-fraction decomposition with three terms, then a definite integral

exercises.prompt_latex: \text{Area bounded by curve }y=\frac{2x}{x^2+1}\text{ and the x-axis on }[1,3];\ \text{area bounded by }y=\sin^2x\text{ and x-axis on }[0,\pi];\ \text{area bounded by }y=x\sin x\text{ and x-axis on }[0,\pi];\ \text{area bounded by parabola }y=4-x^2\text{ and x-axis on }[-2,3];\ \text{area bounded by parabola }(P):y=x^2+2x\text{ and line }(d):y=x+2;\ \text{area bounded by parabola }(P):y=x^2\text{ and line }(d):y=x+2\text{ on }[-1,2];\ \text{area bounded by curves }(C_1):y=x^2-2x\text{ and }(C_2):y=4-x^2\text{ on }[-1,2];\ \text{area bounded by parabola }(P):y=x^2-3x+2,\text{ line }(d):y=x-1,\text{ and vertical lines }x=0,x=2
exercises.technique: Area between a curve (or two curves) and the x-axis or a line, computed as a definite integral of the difference; each item accompanied by a sketch of the shaded region in the book
Semester-2 review bank (section II.1-2): power-rule and reciprocal/partial-fraction bounded integral drills

exercises.technique: Semester-2 review bank (section II.3-4): exponential and trig bounded-integral drills, including u-substitution exponential forms and trig power/angle-shift forms

Semester-2 review bank (section II.5-21): partial-fraction-then-integrate drills followed by a curated bank of real BAC II definite-integral exam problems by year (2015-2023, typically 3 sub-integrals per year: polynomial, trig, and a partial-fraction/rational one)
